jobs.title: Vulnerability Researcher (Remote)
jobs.description: Role Title : Vulnerability Researcher (Remote) Role Type : Project-based Location : Remote Cybersecurity professionals are invited to contribute vulnerability-research expertise to a paid, part-time AI training project. You will create code repositories containing OSS-fuzz-style vulnerabilities and develop correct patches for those vulnerabilities. The project focuses on cybersecurity workflows and draws on practical vulnerability research. Its asynchronous structure is designed to fit around a full-time role, including work completed during evenings or weekends. Scope of Work 1. Generate code repositories containing OSS-fuzz-style vulnerabilities for cybersecurity training tasks. 2. Apply hands-on vulnerability-research experience to the vulnerabilities represented in each repository. 3. Produce correct patches that address the vulnerabilities included in the task. Required Qualifications 1. At least 1 year of hands-on experience in vulnerability research. 2. Cybersecurity expertise relevant to generating vulnerable code repositories and producing correct patches. Compensation and Schedule This is paid work compensated per accepted task. The applicable rate requires confirmation before participation. Work is fully asynchronous, with no set hours or required meetings. Tasks can be completed on your own schedule, including evenings and weekends. What You’ll Do 1. Generate code repositories containing OSS-fuzz-style vulnerabilities for cybersecurity training tasks. 2. Apply hands-on vulnerability-research experience to the vulnerabilities represented in each repository. 3. Produce correct patches that address the vulnerabilities included in the task. Apply Now!

jobs.title: Consultant ou consultante Oracle Cloud Security
jobs.description: En raison du lieu de publication, cette offre d'emploi est disponible uniquement en anglais. Your role, your impact As an Oracle Cloud Security Consultant, you’ll play a critical role in designing, implementing, and managing security controls and risk mitigation strategies across Oracle Cloud applications. You’ll leverage your expertise in Oracle Cloud Security, role-based access control (RBAC) , role design, custom controls, Segregation of Duties (SoD), Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Oracle Risk Management to safeguard enterprise data and systems while supporting regulatory and industry best-practice requirements. Your ability to translate security requirements into secure Oracle Cloud solutions, manage access controls, identify and mitigate risks, and collaborate with business and IT teams will directly contribute to secure Oracle Cloud environments, compliance readiness, effective risk management, and protection of enterprise data and systems.
